messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Johnson <sara.johnson@verdanthealth.com>, Dr. Emily Carter <emily.carter@verdanthealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, dev_patel@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: POC Success Criteria & RACI — Verdant Health

Hi Sara / Emily —

Thanks again for taking time today. Per our call, I wanted to capture the agreed next steps and the proposed POC evaluation plan so we have a single working doc to iterate on. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of objectives (from your team):
- Validate inference latency and tail latency under typical clinic load (avg 8 concurrent sessions, peak 20)
- Verify cost per 1k tokens and projected monthly spend for triage use case
- Confirm data handling and audit logs meet Verdant compliance requirements
- Confirm integration approach (API vs on-prem connector) and ownership for infra/app/security/procurement

Draft success criteria (proposed):
1) Latency: 95th percentile <= 350ms for short prompts (<=128 tokens) under target concurrency
2) Cost: unit token cost within 15% of the demo estimate we shared
3) Security: SOC 2 evidence & encrypted-at-rest verification completed; no blockers in questionnaire
4) Integration: End-to-end demo in staging with their sample dataset and one clinician workflow tested

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): finalize scope & RACI, share signed SOW or PO to kick off environment access
- Week 1: access provided, security questionnaire returned (we'll assign an engineer for onboarding)
- Week 2: baseline runs and latency/cost benchmarks
- Week 3: integration test and joint customer demo

Ownership / RACI (initial call notes):
- Verdant infra: Tom Williams (Procurement + infra provisioning) — owner for VPC/network and credentials
- Verdant app: Dr. Emily Carter (Clinical lead) — owner for test cases and acceptance criteria
- Verdant security: Sara Johnson — point for questionnaire and evidence
- Redwood infra onboarding: Dev Patel — set up staging, model routing, KV caching config
- Redwood integration/POC lead: Marissa Cole — PM for the engagement and demo coordination
- Exec sponsor / escalation: Rishi Malhotra — internal escalation & SLA conversation

Attachments: verdant_poc_scope_v1.pdf (POC scope, 2 pages) and the security questionnaire template.

Next steps (for this week):
- Sara/Tom: confirm procurement contact and target date for PO (reply here)
- Tom: confirm who will provision staging network and provide access
- Verdant: complete and return the security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx by EOD Friday
- Redwood: Dev to schedule onboarding slot once we have access; Marissa will book the week 3 demo calendar hold

Thanks — look forward to moving this forward.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198

Thanks Marissa — great recap and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side:

- Procurement/PO: Tom is our lead — he'll confirm budget and timing. Tom, can you aim to provide a PO by next Thursday (03/11)?

Thanks — quick tech notes / asks from the Redwood infra side so we can size the staging environment: 

1) For the 8 concurrent / 20 peak sessions, can you confirm estimated avg tokens per session? (we used 350 tokens/session as a placeholder)
2) Will you provide sample sanitized payloads and a sample clinician workflow (we can use these in our perf tests)
3) Network: for VPC peering we need the CIDR and any firewall rules that block egress. If Verdant prefers an API integration over VPC, we'll need a service account and IP allowlist.
4) Data retention: confirm retention windows for logs and KV cache content — SOC 2 requirement affects config.

Once we have those, I'll spin up a staging cluster and share SSH + API keys via the secure link. I'll also run a baseline perf test and share results in ~48 hours.

—
